description: Enhance HTTP Adapter with robust polling and webhook callback support
steps: In src/nexus/adapters/http_adapter.py, enhance _poll_for_result() to accept configurable poll_interval, max_polls, timeout parameters with proper error handling (distinct timeout vs connection errors, exponential backoff option)

Add register_callback_handler(callback_url, session, handler_fn) method that stores callback handlers keyed by session/task and provides a way for the adapter to receive async webhook results instead of polling
Add CallbackRegistration dataclass to hold callback_url, handler function reference, registered_at timestamp, and expiry
Add _handle_callback_result(task_id, result_data) method that resolves pending async tasks via stored callbacks

Create tests/test_http_adapter_webhook.py with tests covering: successful poll flow (202 -> poll -> completed), poll timeout, poll with connection errors, callback registration, callback handler invocation, and configurable poll parameters
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_http_adapter_webhook.py passes all new tests
_poll_for_result() supports configurable poll_interval, max_polls, timeout parameters
register_callback_handler() method exists and stores callback configuration
Existing HTTPAdapter behavior (synchronous 200 responses) is unchanged
